entries.97faed512af433a9: Mainly for the game industry, the business provides audio and video middleware to make game development smooth and efficient, image optimisation solutions, sound production and other services. The company, TWO FIVE Co., Ltd. and Shanghai Xiai Information Technology Co., Ltd. handle these products. Revenue for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥1,807 million.
entries.d5ef39a3d1a5a577: A company that provides "CRIWARE," audio and video middleware, and "OPTPiX," an image optimization solution, to the game industry and to companies in mobility and other fields.
